defaults.setup: Create valid real temporary Runs and inject the indexed deterministic publication boundary, contention, cancellation, or subprocess condition.
defaults.action: Exercise create_run or submit_candidate through the core dispatcher or real child process, then inspect exact disk state.

rows.oracle: Every pre-rename fault exposes no Run; successful no-replace rename exposes one complete flushed Run and never overwrites.
JSON becomes visible before Markdown and the Markdown commit marker exposes exactly one complete valid StepArtifact.
Every mutation holds the fixed exclusive lock with an opaque identity; diagnostic age/PID never authorizes mutation.
Contention fails immediately without changing the lock, read-only operations pass, and only confirmed exact-ID recovery succeeds.
Locked re-inspection rejects stale context, advanced attempt, ineligible work, or stale refresh base before allocation.
Pre-critical abort commits nothing; post-critical abort leaves one complete attempt; explicit cancelled outcome commits distinct history.
Fault controls are unavailable from public operation and package surfaces and production values are unchanged.
Every named Run/Step filesystem boundary and before/after-commit process kill has an unambiguous absent-or-complete oracle.
At least 100 retained seeds per race family elect the specified winners with contiguous history; any flake retains reproduction facts and fails.
After response loss, exact inspection distinguishes no commit from the exact committed attempt without a replay.
